results.title: Cloud GPU providers ranked by H100 price, Sep 2026
highlights:
## TL;DR

- Ranked by lowest listed on-demand H100 price per GPU-hour, checked 28 September 2026: RunPod $2.89, Lambda $3.29, Nebius $3.85, Crusoe $3.90, Modal $3.95, Together AI $3.99, DigitalOcean $4.41, CoreWeave $6.16.
- The top two prices are for H100 PCIe. Among the other H100 listings, RunPod’s H100 SXM at $3.49 is still the cheapest. 1 
- Billing units differ. Modal and DigitalOcean bill by the second, Lambda by the minute, Crusoe and Together AI by the hour, and CoreWeave prices a whole 8-GPU node. 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 3 
- Commitment cuts the rate. Together AI lists $3.19 for 91 to 180 days and DigitalOcean $3.26 on a 12-month contract. The other six give a maximum discount, a cluster rate or a sales contact instead of a reserved H100 price. 8, 5 
- The order moves on 1 October 2026, when Nebius lists $4.50 and drops from third to seventh. 9

...

## Which cloud GPU providers rent H100s, and which is cheapest?

All eight rent H100s on demand, and RunPod is cheapest at $2.89 per GPU-hour. More GPU and serving-cost analysis sits in our model infrastructure research.

| Rank | Provider | H100 listing ranked | On-demand price (USD per GPU-hour, as listed) | Price as the provider lists it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | RunPod | H100 PCIe 80 GB | 2.89 | $2.89/hr, Secure Cloud 1, 11 |
| 2 | Lambda | H100 PCIe 80 GB, single-GPU instance | 3.29 | $3.29 per GPU-hour 2 |
| 3 | Nebius | HGX H100 | 3.85 | $3.85 per GPU-hour; $4.50 from 1 October 2026 9 |
| 4 | Crusoe | HGX H100 80 GB | 3.90 | $3.90/GPU-hr 7 |
| 5 | Modal | H100 SXM5 | 3.95 | $0.001097 per second 4 |
| 6 | Together AI | HGX H100, GPU Clusters | 3.99 | $3.99 per GPU per hour 8 |
| 7 | DigitalOcean | HGX H100 | 4.41 | $4.41/GPU/hour 5 |
| 8 | CoreWeave | HGX H100, 8-GPU node, North America | 6.16 | $49.24 per node-hour 3 |

Five of the eight fall between $3.85 and $4.41. The spread at the edges is wider: $2.89 at the bottom and $6.16 at the top.

...

## Which GPUs does each provider list?

Every provider lists more than the H100, and all eight also list at least one Blackwell B200 or B300 system. The lists below are what each pricing page names, including models priced only through sales.

| Provider | H100 variants listed | Other GPUs on the pricing page |
| --- | --- | --- |

| Lambda | SXM 80 GB, PCIe 80 GB | B200 SXM6, GH200, A100 SXM and PCIe, A10, A6000, Tesla V100, Quadro RTX 6000 2 |
| Nebius | HGX H100 | GB300 NVL72, GB200 NVL72, HGX B300, HGX B200, HGX H200, RTX PRO 6000, L40S 9 |
| Crusoe | HGX H100 80 GB | GB200 NVL72, B200, H200, A100 SXM and PCIe 80 GB, L40S, AMD MI355X, AMD MI300X 7 |
| Modal | H100 SXM5 | B300, B200, H200 SXM, RTX PRO 6000, A100 80 GB and 40 GB, L40S, A10, L4, T4 4 |
| Together AI | HGX H100 | GB200 NVL72, GB300 NVL72, HGX B200, HGX B300, HGX H200 8 |
| DigitalOcean | HGX H100 | HGX B300, HGX H200, RTX 4000 Ada, RTX 6000 Ada, L40S, AMD MI355X, MI350X, MI325X, MI300X 5 |
| CoreWeave | HGX H100 | GB300 NVL72, GB200 NVL72, HGX B300, HGX B200, HGX H200, GH200, RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, L40S, L40, A100 3 |

...

Six of the eight state a price per GPU-hour, Modal states a price per second and CoreWeave states a price per 8-GPU node-hour. The metering behind the headline differs again.

| Provider | Price unit on the page | Metering stated | Smallest H100 unit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| RunPod | per GPU-hour, with a per-second view | per second 11 | not stated |
| Lambda | per GPU-hour | by the minute 6 | 1 GPU (PCIe and SXM) |
| Nebius | per GPU-hour | not stated in the capture | not stated |
| Crusoe | per GPU-hour | by the hour 7 | not stated |
| Modal | per GPU-second | per second; CPU and memory billed separately 4 | not stated |
| Together AI | per GPU-hour | hourly 8 | cluster, size not stated |
| DigitalOcean | per GPU-hour | per second, 5-minute minimum 5 | 1 or 8 GPUs |
| CoreWeave | per 8-GPU node-hour | not stated in the capture | 8-GPU node 3 |

The unit matters most for short jobs. Per-second and per-minute metering charge a 20-minute test for about 20 minutes, and DigitalOcean’s 5-minute minimum only bites on runs shorter than that. 5 Crusoe and Together AI describe their GPU pricing in hourly terms, and the captured pages don’t state a shorter increment. 7, 8 

Modal prices the GPU on its own. It charges CPU at $0.0000131 per physical core per second and memory at $0.00000222 per GiB per second on top. 4 RunPod, Lambda, Nebius, DigitalOcean and CoreWeave list vCPUs and memory beside each GPU price. DigitalOcean adds one condition for idle machines: a powered-off GPU Droplet is still billed until it is destroyed.

Commitment and interruptible capacity both cut the on-demand rate. Only Together AI and DigitalOcean publish an exact reserved H100 price; the rest give a maximum discount, a cluster rate or a sales contact.

## What changes the ranking after 28 September 2026?

Nebius’s listed price change on 1 October 2026 moves it from third to seventh. Its HGX H100 goes from $3.85 to $4.50 per GPU-hour, which puts it above DigitalOcean’s $4.41 and below CoreWeave’s $6.16. 9 

Three other dated items bear on the table:

- RunPod’s pricing page is marked “Updated September 27, 2026”, one day before capture. 1 
- DigitalOcean’s current prices took effect on 1 August 2026. 5 
- Together AI’s Dedicated Inference H100 carries a $3.99 promotional rate, down from $5.49, “valid until 09/30/26”. Its GPU Clusters H100 rate of $3.99, the one ranked here, carries no promotion label. 8 

The table is refreshed when any of the nine pricing pages changes.

results.title: DigitalOcean GPU Droplets Review, Pricing & Alternatives | Saaskly
highlights:
The GPU platform came from Paperspace, acquired in July 2023 and still only partly folded in: the Bare Metal GPU page states that a Paperspace account is required to manage payments, and the Paperspace storefront still publishes its own, higher, prices. What was retired is the software layer around it, with the legacy Gradient and Core API endpoints deprecated for Paperspace users from 15 July 2024 and the Gradient Python package carrying a retirement date of 15 August 2026.

...

## What it costs

 Prices are shown in US dollars to a UK visitor, with VAT not stated. All figures read on 22 September 2026.

 An NVIDIA HGX H100 with 80 GB is $4.41 per GPU-hour on demand, which is about $3,219 a month at 730 hours. Commit for 12 months and the same card is $3.26 an hour, roughly $2,380 a month, so the on-demand rate carries a 35 per cent premium. The GPU arrives in a Droplet with 20 vCPU, 240 GiB of RAM, a 720 GiB NVMe boot disk and a 5 TiB NVMe scratch disk, and you can buy one GPU or eight. Eight H100s on demand is $35.28 an hour, about $25,754 a month. An H200 is $4.47 an hour on demand and $3.40 reserved, an AMD MI300X is $2.59 and $1.91, an MI325X is $3.80 and $2.88. The cheapest card of any kind is the RTX 4000 Ada with 20 GB at $0.76 an hour, about $555 a month, in a smaller Droplet with 8 vCPU and 32 GiB of RAM. An L40S or an RTX 6000 Ada is $1.57. Spot capacity exists on the newest parts, but the published spot rates for B300 at $11.19 and MI355X at $4.50 sit above the equivalent on-demand and reserved rates, which contradicts DigitalOcean's own documentation that spot is always at or below on demand.

 Around the compute, block storage volumes are $0.10 per GiB a month and are charged whether or not they are attached to a Droplet. Spaces object storage is $5 a month for 250 GiB of storage and 1 TiB of outbound transfer, with overage at $0.02 per GiB stored and $0.01 per GiB moved, and a cold tier at $0.007 per GiB. Outbound transfer included with a GPU Droplet is 10,000 GiB on the single-GPU plans and 15,000 GiB on the eight-GPU class, pooled across the team, with overage at $0.01 per GiB and free ingress. Billing is per second, although DigitalOcean's pricing page and its documentation disagree on the minimum, the first saying a five-minute minimum billing period and the second 60 seconds or $0.01, whichever is higher. Two things to plan around: a powered-off Droplet is still billed in full, because "the compute resources stay reserved", so destroying it is the only way to stop the meter, and GPU Droplets have no 672-hour monthly cap of the kind CPU Droplets get, so a month of continuous running is 730 billed hours. Billing is postpaid by card.

...

Signup is self-serve with a card, and a GPU Droplet can in principle be launched the same day. What stands in the way is the account limit. DigitalOcean does not publish the default GPU Droplet quota for a new account, and the route to raise it is a request in the control panel under Settings and Profile, or a support ticket, rather than an automatic increase. September 2026 Trustpilot reviews describe a new account restricted from the larger advertised Droplets despite valid payment, with access said to require months of billing history or up to $1,000 prepaid, and a DigitalOcean community question from November 2025 shows a GPU limit increase request going unanswered on the page. Bare Metal GPUs are a different purchase entirely: 8x H100, 8x H200 or 8x MI300X nodes with dual Xeon Platinum CPUs, 2,048 GiB of RAM, 61.44 TiB of NVMe and RDMA interconnect up to 3.2 Tbps, but they are "provisioned via contract with DigitalOcean sales (not on-demand)", with no public price.

...

### H100 80 GB, one GPU

$3,219/mo · month-to-month

$2,380/mo on an annual commitment

Month-to-month costs 35% more

- ✓ One NVIDIA HGX H100 80 GB (20 vCPU / 240 GiB RAM / 720 GiB NVMe boot / 5 TiB NVMe scratch / 15,000 GiB transfer) at $4.41 per GPU-hour on demand, $3,219 a month at 730 hours; reserved from $3.26 per GPU-hour ($2,380 a month) on a 12-month commitment, a 35 per cent gap. Eight H100s on demand are $35.28 an hour, about $25,754 a month. USD, VAT not stated, read 22 Sep 2026.

results.title: AMD旗舰GPU仅需4美元每小时，DigitalOcean上线Spot GPU实例 - 技术栈
highlights:
# AMD旗舰GPU仅需4美元每小时，DigitalOcean上线Spot GPU实例

DO_Community 2026-09-05 16:48

在AI算力成本居高不下的今天，DigitalOcean给开发者带来了一个好消息： AMD Instinct MI350X 与 MI355X Spot GPU实例现已降价，每小时仅需4美元。

### 什么是Spot GPU实例？

Spot GPU实例使用的是DigitalOcean平台上的闲置GPU容量，以远低于按需实例的价格提供给用户。它与按需实例的核心区别在于：

| 对比维度 | 按需GPU Droplet | Spot GPU Droplet |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 容量保障 | 创建后容量持续保留，直到主动销毁 | 使用闲置GPU容量，不保证持续可用 |
| 定价方式 | 固定小时费率 | 价格每日可能变动，但始终低于或等于按需价格 |
| 回收机制 | 不会被平台回收 | 平台可能回收实例，通常会提前至少2小时邮件通知 |
| 适用场景 | 生产推理、延迟敏感应用、有状态工作负载 | 批处理训练、批量推理、超参数调优、渲染等容错型任务 |

Spot GPU实例适合那些可以保存进度、中断后能重启并迁移到其他实例的容错型工作负载，比如批量模型训练、异步推理、超参数调优和渲染任务。

目前，DigitalOcean上的GPU Droplet云服务器型号包括 AMD MI355X、MI350X、MI325X、MI300X，以及 NVIDIA B300、H200、H100等多种型号，具体价格与折扣可联系DigitalOcean中国区战略合作伙伴卓普云（aidroplet.com）咨询。

### 三款旗舰GPU，价格诚意满满

目前DigitalOcean Spot GPU实例提供三款旗舰GPU型号：

| GPU型号 | Spot实例价格（/GPU/小时） | 预留实例价格（/GPU/小时） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AMD Instinct MI350X | $4.00 | $4.76 |
| AMD Instinct MI355X | $4.50 | 仅提供Spot实例 |
| NVIDIA HGX B300 | $11.19 | $7.94 |

AMD MI350X以4.00美元/GPU/小时的价格，成为目前DigitalOcean平台上最具性价比的旗舰GPU选择。 NVIDIA B300的Spot价格为11.19美元/GPU/小时。

...

Spot GPU实例有一个非常友好的特点：创建时的定价会被锁定，在实例的整个生命周期内保持不变，无需长期预留承诺。这意味着你可以以一个极具竞争力的价格长期使用高端GPU算力。

results.title: Nebius raises GPU prices again October 1; H100 to $4.50, B300 to $9.50 | GPU Cloud Advisors
highlights:
# Nebius raises GPU prices again October 1; H100 to $4.50, B300 to $9.50

Nebius lists higher on demand GPU prices effective October 1, 2026. H100 rises from $3.85 to $4.50 per GPU hour. H200 rises from $4.50 to $5.40, B200 from $7.15 to $8.50, and B300 from $7.85 to $9.50. This round is 17% to 21%. It is reported to be the second increase since May. [1] [2]

Published September 28, 2026 Announced, effective October 1, 2026

## Disclosed terms

HGX H100, per GPU hour

$3.85 now, $4.50 from October 1 [1]

HGX H200, per GPU hour

$4.50 now, $5.40 from October 1 [1]

HGX B200, per GPU hour

$7.15 now, $8.50 from October 1 [1]

HGX B300, per GPU hour

$7.85 now, $9.50 from October 1 [1]

...

### What changed

Nebius's pricing page now shows two on demand columns: today's rate and a rate effective October 1, 2026. H100 rises 17%, H200 20%, B200 19% and B300 21%. [1]

Spot rates still start at $0.79 for H100 and H200 and $0.99 for B200 and B300. RTX PRO 6000 stays at $1.80. CPU only instances also rise. Nebius still advertises commitment discounts of up to 35% off on demand for multi month cluster reservations. [1]

Nebius's pricing page does not give a reason for the change.

...

H200: At $5.40, Nebius moves above Runpod ($4.59) and Verda ($4.55). It stays below Together AI ($5.99) and CoreWeave (about $6.31 per GPU).

B200: At $8.50, Nebius moves well above Lambda ($6.69) and Runpod ($6.79). CoreWeave's 8 GPU instance works out to about $8.60 per GPU.

...

Configurations differ. vCPUs, memory, storage, networking and minimum allocation all vary. A lower hourly rate is not a lower project cost on its own.

...

If you run on Nebius on demand today, your bill goes up October 1 unless your contract says otherwise. Check whether your agreement fixes the rate.

highlights: According to media reports, Nebius will raise prices for some of its on-demand computing resources starting October 1, marking the company's second round of price increases since May. Under the new pricing plan, the price of H100 will rise from $3.85 per GPU hour to $4.50, an increase of about 17%; H200 will rise 20% from $4.50 to $5.40; B200 will rise nearly 19% from $7.15 to $8.50; and B300 will rise about 21% from $7.85 per GPU hour to $9.50. The changes also extend to CPU-only compute. AMD EPYC Genoa CPU rates will rise 25% to $0.015 per vCPU-hour from $0.012, while Genoa memory will increase about 41% to $0.0045 per GiB-hour from $0.0032. The ultimate impact on customers' bills will therefore depend on their configurations and usage.

results.title: Nebius to Raise GPU Cloud Pricing Across H100, H200
results.author: MarketCatalyst Desk
highlights:
# Nebius to Raise GPU Cloud Pricing Across H100, H200, B200 and B300 Starting Oct. 1

Nebius will raise on-demand GPU cloud pricing across H100, H200, B200 and B300 starting October 1, as it scales capacity and secures financing tied to deployed GPUs.

Published Sep 17, 2026 · 4:44 PM ET · 4 min read

...

Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) is planning to raise prices on several of its on-demand GPU, CPU, and memory services starting October 1, according to a customer pricing notice reviewed by MarketCatalyst. The adjustments touch the company's most sought-after compute tiers — NVIDIA's H100, H200, B200, and B300 chips — and follow a strong second quarter shaped by rising AI Cloud demand.

...

## What's Changing

The notice lists new per-GPU-hour rates across four NVIDIA chip families, plus adjustments to underlying CPU and memory pricing:

| Hardware | New Rate | Previous Rate | Region(s) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| NVIDIA H100 | $4.50 / GPU-hr | $3.85 / GPU-hr | eu-north1 |
| NVIDIA H200 | $5.40 / GPU-hr | $4.50 / GPU-hr | Listed European & U.S. regions |
| NVIDIA B200 | $8.50 / GPU-hr | $7.15 / GPU-hr | us-central1, me-west1 |
| NVIDIA B300 | $9.50 / GPU-hr | $7.85 / GPU-hr | uk-south1, eu-west2, us-north1 |

The increases range from roughly 15% for the H100 and H200 to about 21% for the B300, which sees the largest adjustment of the four. AMD EPYC Genoa CPU and memory rates are also moving slightly higher as part of the same notice, while Intel Ice Lake CPU pricing remains unchanged.

The bottom line

Every chip seeing a price increase is a current-generation or near-current NVIDIA accelerator used for AI training and inference, rather than older, lower-demand hardware. This pattern is consistent with a company adjusting prices where capacity is tightest, rather than where it may be trying to move idle inventory.

...

The rate changes are set to take effect October 1 across the regions listed above. Customers with existing reserved or contracted capacity commitments are typically governed by separate contract terms rather than these on-demand list prices, though the notice offers a useful signal on the broader direction of AI compute costs as capacity remains tight across the industry.

...

### When do Nebius's new GPU prices take effect?

According to a customer pricing notice, the new rates for H100, H200, B200, and B300 GPUs, along with AMD EPYC Genoa CPU and memory pricing, are set to take effect October 1.

### How much are Nebius's GPU prices increasing?

H100 pricing in eu-north1 is set to rise to $4.50 per GPU-hour from $3.85. H200 pricing is set to rise to $5.40 per GPU-hour from $4.50 across listed European and U.S. regions. B200 pricing in us-central1 and me-west1 is set to rise to $8.50 from $7.15 per GPU-hour. B300 pricing in uk-south1, eu-west2, and us-north1 is set to rise to $9.50 from $7.85 per GPU-hour.
